title: User can set notification preferences for email
gherkin:
Feature: Notification Preference Rule
  Scenario: User sets email notification preference
    Given a user is logged into the system
    When the user navigates to notification preferences
    And the user selects email as the notification channel
    And the user enables email notifications
    Then the email notification preference should be saved
    And the user should receive notifications via email
rationale: Verifies that users can configure email as a notification channel and that preferences are persisted.
generationSummary: Notification preference rule - Test cases covering the ability to set, manage, and apply user notification preferences across different notification types and channels.

title: User can disable notifications for a specific channel
gherkin:
Feature: Notification Preference Rule
  Scenario: User disables notifications for a channel
    Given a user has enabled email notifications
    When the user navigates to notification preferences
    And the user disables email notifications
    Then the email notification preference should be updated
    And the user should not receive notifications via email
rationale: Verifies that users can opt-out of notifications for specific channels.

    Then the preference for that notification type should be saved
    And the user should receive notifications of that type

title: System applies notification preferences when sending notifications
gherkin:
Feature: Notification Preference Rule
  Scenario: System respects user notification preferences
    Given a user has set notification preferences
    When the system triggers a notification event
    Then the system should check the user's notification preferences
    And the system should only send the notification through enabled channels
    And the system should not send notifications through disabled channels
rationale: Verifies that the system enforces user notification preferences when delivering notifications.
generationSummary: Notification preference rule - Test cases covering the ability to set, manage, and apply user notification preferences across different notification types and channels.

    When the user logs in for the first time
    Then the system should apply default notification preferences
    And the user should be able to modify these preferences

title: User can reset notification preferences to defaults
gherkin:
Feature: Notification Preference Rule

    When the user navigates to notification preferences
    And the user selects the option to reset to defaults
    Then all notification preferences should be reset to system defaults
    And the user should receive a confirmation message
